instruction: Look at task-014_initial.scad. Modify the support pin into a D-flat retaining pin. Keep a coaxial insertion shaft of diameter 5 mm and length 18 mm, and add an exposed shoulder of diameter 12 mm and thickness 6 mm at one end, so the final total length is 24 mm. Cut a D-shaped flat along the insertion shaft with the flat plane at y=1.5 mm from the center over z=0 to z=18. Add a 1.2 mm wide annular circlip groove around the shoulder, centered at z=21 mm, with groove root diameter 10 mm; use rotate_extrude() or an equivalent annular cut. Fully render and export /home/user/Desktop/task-014_output.stl. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
